title: WS-133: which option for person-folder code in the release build (blocks WS-137's infographic button in the site build)
detail: Until decided, WS-137's drawing code runs only in the browser. Options on WS-133; measured by dev@web-summit.indi on 5 November.
recommend: Option 1, with the version number worked out in the read-only job
options: 1: build person pages in the read-only job
2: persist-credentials false, plus hooksPath and no OIDC for the build
